# Nithusha Sivarasa

> Full Stack Web Developer based in Point Pedro, Jaffna, Sri Lanka. Builds full stack web
> applications end to end using C#, .NET Core, Angular, React and Next.js, with SQL Server
> and PostgreSQL databases and REST API integration.

Nithusha is currently a Software Developer (Full Stack) at Thriio (remote, France), and
previously interned as a Full Stack Developer at UNICOM TIC. She holds a Diploma in Full
Stack Development from Unicom TIC and is pursuing a Bachelor of Information Technology
(External Degree) at the University of Moratuwa.

She is open to full-time opportunities and can be contacted via WhatsApp or email through
the links on her portfolio site.

- Individual project case studies are linked from the Projects section, each covering the
